_comment: Media ingest rules for in-world video screens (docs/design/media-player.md, 'Transcode on ingest'). video_extensions: what the in-app Open picker lists (lower case, no dot). ffmpeg_candidates: where the app looks for ffmpeg after the Settings > Media path and the PATH environment variable, in order; %NAME% expands to that environment variable on Windows. Edit this file to add a location; nothing here is compiled in except as the fallback copy for an exe shipped without its data folder.
